  • 枚举常量概要

    枚举常量
    枚举常量
    说明
    BED
    已过时。
    No longer used 不再使用
    BREEDING
    When an animal breeds to create a child 当动物繁殖产生后代时
    BUILD_IRONGOLEM
    When an iron golem is spawned by being built 当铁傀儡经由搭建生成时
    BUILD_SNOWMAN
    When a snowman is spawned by being built 当雪人经由搭建生成时
    BUILD_WITHER
    When a wither boss is spawned by being built 当凋灵 Boss 经由搭建生成时
    CHUNK_GEN
    When a creature spawns due to chunk generation 当生物因区块生成而出现时
    CURED
    When a villager is cured from infection 当村民从感染中被治愈时
    CUSTOM
    When a creature is spawned by plugins 当生物由插件生成时
    DEFAULT
    When an entity is missing a SpawnReason 当实体缺少 SpawnReason 时
    DISPENSE_EGG
    When a creature is spawned by a dispenser dispensing an egg 当生物由发射器发射蛋而生成时
    EGG
    When a creature spawns from an egg 当生物从蛋生成时
    INFECTION
    When a zombie infects a villager 当僵尸感染村民时
    JOCKEY
    When an entity spawns as a jockey of another entity (mostly spider jockeys) 当实体作为另一实体的骑乘者生成时（多为蜘蛛骑士）
    LIGHTNING
    When a creature spawns because of a lightning strike 当生物因雷击而生成时
    MOUNT
    When an entity spawns as a mount of another entity (mostly chicken jockeys) 当实体作为另一实体的坐骑生成时（多为鸡骑士）
    NATURAL
    When something spawns from natural means 当某个实体以自然方式生成时
    NETHER_PORTAL
    When a creature is spawned by nether portal 当生物经由下界传送门生成时
    OCELOT_BABY
    When an ocelot has a baby spawned along with them 当豹猫生成时附带生成幼崽
    REINFORCEMENTS
    When an entity calls for reinforcements 当实体呼叫增援时
    SILVERFISH_BLOCK
    When a silverfish spawns from a block 当蠹虫从方块中生成时
    SLIME_SPLIT
    When a slime splits 当史莱姆分裂时
    SPAWNER
    When a creature spawns from a spawner 当生物从刷怪笼生成时
    SPAWNER_EGG
    When a creature spawns from a Spawner Egg 当生物从刷怪蛋生成时
    VILLAGE_DEFENSE
    When an iron golem is spawned to defend a village 当铁傀儡为保卫村庄而生成时
    VILLAGE_INVASION
    When a zombie is spawned to invade a village 当僵尸为入侵村庄而生成时
